target.pin_policy: Resolve GitHub stable and npm latest together before a campaign; pin version, release commit and package integrity for its duration. Historical bootstrap runs are excluded from current-release conclusions.

rules: Historical failures are retained as evidence.
Quarantined results and preparation/calibration are excluded.
Same version is necessary but not sufficient: compare workload, topology, grants, model, fault and observation scope.
Quantitative cross-product comparison requires matched conditions or explicit stratification.
Missing raw metrics are unknown; acceptance pass/fail cannot reconstruct CPU, tokens or latency.
Historical observations keep original IDs and never count as new independent repetitions.

studies.remaining_gap: Matched deployment and same confirmed interruption boundary for the other products.
Matched public entry, identity contract and integration work for the other products.
Resource-matched hosts/deployments and shared task definitions; old bounded hardware measurements are not a cross-product baseline.
Native memory write/update/retrieval provenance and identical next-request controls; old reference context engine is not the default engine.
Same-work single/two-child paired acceptance and all parent/child stage resources.
Current shared topology and route-specific filesystem/network/process witnesses; preserve original grants and threat model.
Matched DSH execution; native event subscriber versus OTLP collector semantics; complete diagnostic overhead ledger.
Selectable restore scope, peer agents/sessions/OS witnesses and actual affected footprint; backup creation does not prove restore.
Separate context pressure/output limits/goal guardrails. Shared hard task-tree budget already verified absent at this pin; native skill/context ablations still need binding.
COST-03 is agent-written guide reuse, not native Workshop feedback/validation/version reversal or sealed transfer/regression.
